beats.say: This is how the high voltage from the wall gets stepped down to something safe.
A transformer is two coils sharing an iron core. It only works with alternating current.
The changing current in the first coil makes a changing magnetic field, which drives a current in the second coil.
The voltage changes by the ratio of the turns. Fewer turns on the second coil means a lower voltage.
Next time: the zener. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

youtube.learn: How a transformer uses two coils and an iron core, why it needs AC, and how the turns ratio sets the voltage.
